claim: The trapping laser's power is neither readable nor settable from software. The level is set by a hand control and nothing reads it back, so a level used in a run leaves no record unless someone writes it down.
validity_conditions: Ruled TRANSFER under 10.2.1 and passed 10.3 rule 1, so it caps at E3 -- a run taken in another project is not a run taken here. 10.2's hardware-control-path row is open and says in its own rule that it does not wait for envelope/, because wrapping a control path needs no safety limit. Slot: A7, which owns the driving term, with the orchestrator second. This is why the detection bound in trap_heating_detection_bound is stated as a dial position and not as a power: there is no path by which the number could have been read back, so a recalled dial setting is the strongest form that fact can take. It also means a run's laser level is not recoverable from any log after the fact.
